name: Return to Sven
summary: This quest marks the moment Sven Yorgen finally learns the truth behind the brutal massacre of his family at the Yorgen Farmstead. After tracking down the runaway Jitters, you return to Sven's isolated camp on the edge of Westfall carrying the vagrant's completed journal. The journal promises answers to the questions that have haunted Sven since the attack.

sections.title: A Coward's Confession
sections.body: When Sven Yorgen's farm was attacked, Jitters fled into the woods in terror, leaving behind only an incomplete diary amidst the slaughter. Terrified of Sven's wrath and haunted by what he witnessed, Jitters hid deep within Duskwood. When confronted, he hands over his completed journal willingly, desperately hoping that providing the full story of the attack will spare him from having to face the vengeful farmer in person.

sections.title: Unmasking the Dark Riders
sections.body: Reading Jitters' finished account finally connects the horrifying pieces for Sven. The slaughter at his farm was not a random undead surge or feral beast attack; it was carried out by the enigmatic Dark Riders searching for an artifact. Furthermore, Sven recalls witnessing these very same hooded figures meeting secretly with the necromancer Morbent Fel near the Forlorn Rowe. Jitters' journal transforms Sven's blind sorrow into a targeted hunt for retribution against the dark wizard.

faq.q: Why is Jitters so terrified of Sven Yorgen?
faq.answer: Jitters fled Sven's farm and dreads facing the grieving farmer's wrath. He asks you to deliver his journal so Sven can read his account.

faq.q: What is in Jitters' completed journal?
faq.answer: It is Jitters' full account of the events at Sven's farm. Sven needs to read it to understand what happened to his family.

faq.q: Who are the Dark Riders mentioned by Sven?
faq.answer: The Dark Riders are mysterious, hooded cloaked figures roaming Duskwood. Ruthless and deadly, they entered the forest searching relentlessly for powerful magical relics, leaving death and ruin wherever they tread.

faq.q: How is Morbent Fel connected to the attack on Sven's farm?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel is a powerful necromancer in western Duskwood. His connection to the attack is uncovered through Sven's investigation and Jitters' journal.

faq.q: Where can Sven Yorgen be found?
faq.answer: Sven has abandoned his ruined farmstead and now resides at a small, tense encampment tucked against the northwestern hills of Duskwood, near the border crossing into Westfall.

faq.q: What happens after giving Sven the journal?
aliases: next quest after return to sven
faq.answer: Sven reads Jitters' completed account and asks you to prove your combat abilities in the next task, Proving Your Worth.

angles.text: The tragic demise of the Yorgen Farmstead is a stark reminder of Stormwind's complete failure to protect Duskwood's frontier settlements from the encroaching shadows.
Helping Sven uncover the forces behind his family's murder serves the holy duty to protect the innocent and seek justice.
